input: Explain AI Testing for LLMs, contrasting it with traditional testing in terms of output variability and validation methods.
expected_output: AI Testing for LLMs involves evaluating the quality, accuracy, relevance, safety, and reliability of responses, which may vary probabilistically for the same prompt. Python & DeepEval for AI Hallucination Testing

Introduction

This document summarizes the Python, AI Testing, and DeepEval concepts used while building an AI Hallucination Testing Framework. It focuses on practical knowledge rather than exhaustive theory.

AI Testing

AI Testing validates the quality, accuracy, relevance, safety, and reliability of responses generated by Large Language Models (LLMs). Unlike traditional software testing, AI outputs are probabilistic and may vary for the same prompt.

Traditional Testing vs AI Testing

Metric-based evaluation

Deterministic

Quality scoring

Python Fundamentals

Installation & Setup

Install Python, VS Code and Python extension. Verify using python --version and pip --version.

Variables & Data Types

Use int, float, string and boolean values. Python automatically determines the data type.

Lists

Ordered collections used to store prompts, datasets and results.

Dictionaries

Key-value collections used for structured data and report generation.

Conditions & Loops

if/else, for and while loops are used to process datasets and execute logic.

Functions

Functions organize reusable logic such as loading datasets, generating responses and evaluating results.

File Handling

Read Excel, text and JSON files. Write reports to Excel.

Script Execution

Run Python scripts directly or execute automated tests using PyTest.

NumPy & Pandas

NumPy provides efficient numerical operations. Pandas is the primary library used in this project for reading Excel files, creating DataFrames, filtering data, and writing execution reports.

Understanding LLMs

Large Language Models (LLMs) understand and generate human language. Examples include ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Llama and Phi-3. This project uses Phi-3 through Ollama.

AI Hallucinations

A hallucination occurs when an LLM confidently generates information that is incorrect or unsupported by the provided context.
